Definition: an Ekronite or inhabitant of Ekron
BiblicalUsage: ʻEqrôwnîy is the word for an Ekronite or inhabitant of Ekron. It occurs twice, in 1 Samuel and Joshua.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe ʻEqrôwnîy is best left as Scripture leaves it: Ekronite or inhabitant of Ekron.
